<text x='0' y='30' font-size='24' font-weight='bold' fill='%230E0E0C'>Crop prices and rates moved in farmers' favour this year. Housing starts kept falling.
<text x='0' y='70' font-size='22' fill='%230E0E0C'>July 2026 vs a year earlier: corn +11%25, soybeans +18%25, fed funds 3.63%25 (was 4.33%25), housing starts -13%25.
